## Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
# Assign water year (October 1 – September 30)
water_year <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      date = as.Date(date),
      WaterYear = if_else(
        month(date) >= 10,
        year(date) + 1L,
        year(date)
      )
    )
}
```

## Import input datasets

```{r load-water-quality}
# Water quality observations
WC_dat <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "DF_water_quality_data_2026.csv")
) %>%
  mutate(
    datetime = ymd_hms(datetime, tz = "UTC"),
    datetime = with_tz(datetime, tzone = local_tz),
    date = as.Date(datetime, tz = local_tz),
    year = year(datetime),
    mon = month(datetime),
    jday = yday(datetime),
    burn_lab = case_when(
      site_lab == "ophir" ~ "unburned",
      site_lab %in% c(
        "davis",
        "winters_usgs",
        "winters_up",
        "browns",
        "browns_sub"
      ) ~ "burn",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

## I. Characterize hydroclimate conditions

- How do sampling events reflect baseflow or runoff conditions?
- When did the largest transport events occur at each site?

### Figure 2. Streamflow, precipitation, and sampling timing

### Runoff and sampling timing as streamflow, sample dates, and ppt 

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=F, fig.width=9, fig.height=6.25}
# 1. Plot settings

plot_start <- as.Date("2024-09-05")
plot_end   <- as.Date("2026-05-15")

site_order <- c(
  "winters_usgs",
  "davis",
  "ophir"
)

site_labs <- c(
  winters_usgs = "Winters USGS",
  davis = "Davis",
  ophir = "Ophir"
)

catchment_area_lookup <- tibble(
  site = c("winters_usgs", "davis", "ophir"),
  catchment_area = c(5.4, 4.3, 50.1)
)

# Functional-flow colors
flow_colors <- c(
  wet_season_baseflow = "#878787",
  dry_season_baseflow = "#878787",
  spring_recession_flow = "#009E73",
  peak_flow = "#303030",
  runoff = "#56B4E9"
)

flow_labels <- c(
  wet_season_baseflow = "Wet-season baseflow",
  dry_season_baseflow = "Dry-season low flow",
  spring_recession_flow = "Spring recession",
  peak_flow = "Peak flow",
  runoff = "Runoff"
)

# 2. Prepare plotting data

df_plot <- df_hydro %>%
  mutate(
    site = as.character(site),
    date = as.Date(date)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    site %in% site_order,
    between(date, plot_start, plot_end)
  ) %>%
  left_join(catchment_area_lookup, by = "site") %>%
  mutate(
    site = factor(site, levels = site_order),
    flow_norm = Q / catchment_area,

    flow_class = case_when(
      functional_component %in% c(
        "fall_pulse_flow",
        "dry_season_runoff",
        "other_runoff"
      ) ~ "runoff",
      TRUE ~ functional_component
    )
  )

# 3. Sampling observations

# Create sampling observation keys
test_keys <- WC_dat %>%
  transmute(
    site = as.character(site_lab),
    date = as.Date(date),
    est_obs = "yes"
  ) %>%
  distinct(site, date, .keep_all = TRUE)

# Remove existing est_obs and join sampling dates
df_plot <- df_plot %>%
  select(-any_of("est_obs")) %>%
  mutate(
    site = tolower(trimws(site)),
    date = as.Date(date)
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    test_keys,
    by = c("site", "date")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    est_obs = coalesce(est_obs, "no")
  )

# 4. Build colored hydrograph segments
flow_lines <- df_plot %>%
  arrange(site, date) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  mutate(
    next_date = lead(date),
    next_flow = lead(flow_norm)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(flow_norm),
    !is.na(next_flow),
    !is.na(flow_class),
    as.integer(next_date - date) == 1L
  )

# 5. Precipitation scaling

# Precipitation scale: 0 mm at top, 60 mm at bottom.
# Bars occupy the upper 25% of each panel, as in
# the original figure.

ppt_max <- 90
ppt_fraction <- 0.5

# 6. Function to plot an individual site

make_site_plot <- function(site_name) {

  site_df <- df_plot %>%
    filter(as.character(site) == site_name)

  site_lines <- flow_lines %>%
    filter(as.character(site) == site_name)

  # Independent discharge scale for each site
  site_Qmax <- max(site_df$flow_norm, na.rm = TRUE)

  if (!is.finite(site_Qmax) || site_Qmax <= 0) {
    site_Qmax <- 1
  }

  Q_top <- site_Qmax * 1.5

  # Precipitation transformation
  ppt_scale <- Q_top * ppt_fraction / ppt_max

  site_df <- site_df %>%
    mutate(
      PPT_ymax = Q_top,
      PPT_ymin = Q_top - precip_mm * ppt_scale
    )

  # Build site-specific panel
  p <- ggplot() +

    # Precipitation bars
    geom_rect(
      data = site_df %>%
        filter(!is.na(precip_mm), precip_mm > 0),
      aes(
        xmin = date - 0.75,
        xmax = date + 0.75,
        ymin = PPT_ymin,
        ymax = PPT_ymax,
        fill = precip_mm
      ),
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +

    scale_fill_gradient(
      low = "#D6EAF8",
      high = "#084594",
      limits = c(0, ppt_max),
      oob = scales::squish,
      name = "Daily precipitation (mm)"
    ) +

    # Colored hydrograph
    geom_segment(
      data = site_lines,
      aes(
        x = date,
        xend = next_date,
        y = flow_norm,
        yend = next_flow,
        color = flow_class
      ),
      linewidth = 0.9,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +

    scale_color_manual(
      values = flow_colors,
      labels = flow_labels,
      name = "Functional flow",
      na.translate = FALSE
    ) +

    # Sampling observations
    geom_point(
      data = site_df %>%
        filter(est_obs == "yes", !is.na(flow_norm)),
      aes(
        x = date,
        y = flow_norm
      ),
      shape = 4,
      color = "black",
      size = 0.75,
      stroke = 1
    ) +

    # Fire containment
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = as.Date("2024-09-25"),
      linetype = "dashed",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +

    # Site label
    facet_grid(
      site ~ .,
      labeller = labeller(
        site = as_labeller(site_labs)
      )
    ) +

    scale_x_date(
      limits = c(plot_start, plot_end),
      date_breaks = "2 months",
      date_labels = "%b-%y",
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    scale_y_continuous(
      name = NULL, #expression( Catchment~normalized~discharge~(m^3~s^-1~km^-2)),
      limits = c(0, Q_top),

      # Right-hand precipitation axis
      sec.axis = sec_axis(
        trans = ~ (Q_top - .) / ppt_scale,
        name = "Daily precipitation (mm)",
        breaks = c(0, 20, 40, 60, 80)
      ),

      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +

    labs(x = "Date") +

    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +

    theme(
      strip.background = element_rect(
        fill = "grey90",
        color = "grey50"
      ),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.spacing = grid::unit(0.6, "lines")
    )

  return(p)
}

# 7. Generate plots in latitude order

p_winters <- make_site_plot("winters_usgs")
p_davis   <- make_site_plot("davis")
p_ophir   <- make_site_plot("ophir")

# 8. Combine panels

Baseflowplot <- (
  p_winters /
  p_davis /
  p_ophir
) +
  plot_layout(
    heights = c(1, 1, 1),
    guides = "collect"
  ) &
  theme(
    legend.position = "right"
  )

Baseflowplot

```

### baseflow transition?

```{r, warning=F, echo=FALSE, include=T}

# 1. Calculate mean September discharge by site/year

september_flow <- df_hydro %>%
  filter(month(date) == 9) %>%
  group_by(site, water_year) %>%
  summarise(
    sept_mean_Q = if (all(is.na(Q))) NA_real_ else mean(Q, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sept_days = sum(!is.na(Q)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    low_flow_min = sept_mean_Q * 0.25,
    low_flow_max = sept_mean_Q * 1.75
  )


# 2. Identify first April–August day within 25%
#    of September mean discharge

dry_season_onset <- df_hydro %>%
  left_join(
    september_flow,
    by = c("site", "water_year")
  ) %>%
  filter(
    month(date) >= 4,
    month(date) <= 8,
    !is.na(Q),
    !is.na(sept_mean_Q),
    Q <= low_flow_max
  ) %>%
  group_by(site, water_year) %>%
  slice_min(
    order_by = date,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    site,
    water_year,
    dry_season_onset = date,
    onset_DOY = yday(date),
    onset_Q = Q,
    sept_mean_Q,
    low_flow_min,
    low_flow_max,
    functional_component
  ) %>%
  arrange(site, water_year)

dry_season_onset
```

Only valid for sites with USGS gages.

### Catchment water quality differences

```{r, warning=F, size = 'small', echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}
    stream_lab == "winters" ~ "p",

```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE}

# 1. Site order and labels

site_order <- c(
  "browns_sub",
  "browns",
  "winters_up",
  "winters_usgs",
  "davis",
  "ophir"
)

site_labels <- c(
  browns_sub   = "Sub",
  browns       = "Browns",
  winters_up   = "Up",
  winters_usgs = "USGS",
  davis        = "Davis",
  ophir        = "Ophir"
)

stream_labels <- c(
  browns_sub   = "Browns",
  browns       = "Browns",
  winters_up   = "Winters",
  winters_usgs = "Winters",
  davis        = "Davis",
  ophir        = "Ophir"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# 2. Revised boxplot function
# --------------------------------------------------

wq_boxplot <- function(
    data,
    y,
    y_lab,
    hline = NULL,
    filter_expr = NULL,
    site_colors = NULL,
    add_anova = TRUE,
    anova_label_digits = 2,
    show_all_p = FALSE
) {

  yq <- enquo(y)
  filterq <- enquo(filter_expr)
  y_name <- as_name(yq)


# Prepare data
  pdat <- data

  if (!quo_is_null(filterq)) {
    pdat <- pdat %>%
      filter(!!filterq)
  }

  pdat <- pdat %>%
    mutate(
      site_lab = tolower(trimws(site_lab)),

      stream = recode(
        site_lab,
        !!!stream_labels,
        .default = NA_character_
      ),

      reach = factor(
        site_lab,
        levels = site_order,
        labels = unname(site_labels[site_order])
      ),

      stream = factor(
        stream,
        levels = c("Browns", "Winters", "Davis", "Ophir")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(
      !is.na(stream),
      !is.na(reach),
      !is.na(!!yq)
    )


# optional- ANOVA comparing STREAMS
  anova_text <- NULL

  if (add_anova) {

    adata <- pdat %>%
      mutate(
        .y_num = as.numeric(!!yq),
        .stream = droplevels(stream)
      ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(.y_num))

    if (
      nrow(adata) >= 3 &&
      n_distinct(adata$.stream) >= 2
    ) {

      fit <- aov(.y_num ~ .stream, data = adata)

      sm <- summary(fit)[[1]]

      Fv <- sm[["F value"]][1]
      df1 <- sm[["Df"]][1]
      df2 <- sm[["Df"]][2]
      pv <- sm[["Pr(>F)"]][1]

      # Show all p-values or only p < 0.09
      if (!is.na(pv) && (show_all_p || pv < 0.07)) {

        fmt_p <- if (pv < 0.001) {
          "p < 0.001"
        } else {
          paste0("p = ", signif(pv, 2))
        }

        anova_text <- paste0(
          "ANOVA (stream)\n",
          "F(", df1, ", ", df2, ") = ",
          round(Fv, anova_label_digits), ", ",
          #"\n",
          fmt_p
        )
      }
    }
  }

# Plot reaches within stream facets
  p <- ggplot(
    pdat,
    aes(
      x = reach,
      y = !!yq,
      fill = reach
    )
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.5,
      alpha = 0.95,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) +
    facet_grid(
      ~ stream,
      scales = "free_x",
      space = "free_x"
    ) +
    scale_x_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = y_lab,
      fill = "Reach"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold",
        size = 11
      ),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.spacing.x = grid::unit(0.5, "lines")
    )

  # Optional colors
  if (!is.null(site_colors)) {

    # Accept colors named by site_lab
    if (all(site_order %in% names(site_lab_colors))) {
      names(site_lab_colors) <- unname(
        site_labels[names(site_lab_colors)]
      )
    }

    p <- p +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = site_lab_colors
      )
  }

  # Optional reference line
  if (!is.null(hline)) {
    p <- p +
      geom_hline(
        yintercept = hline,
        linetype = "dashed"
      )
  }

  # Add stream-level ANOVA annotation

  # if (!is.null(anova_text)) {
  # 
  #   p <- p +
  #     labs(
  #       subtitle = anova_text
  #     )
  # }

  return(p)
}

```

### Suppporting info table

Water chemistry mean, median, range

```{r, echo=F, include=T}

# 1. Define analytes and units
analyte_info <- tribble(
  ~variable,   ~analyte, ~units,
  "DOC_QC",     "DOC",    "mg/L",
  "TOC_QC",     "TOC",    "mg/L",
  "TDN_QC",     "TDN",    "mg/L",
  "NO3.N_QC",   "NO₃-N",  "mg/L",
  "NH4.N_QC",   "NH₄-N",  "mg/L",
  "PO4.P_QC",   "PO₄-P",  "mg/L",
  "TSS_QC",     "TSS",    "mg/L",
  "Al_QC",      "Al",     "µg/L",
  "As_QC",      "As",     "µg/L",
  "B_QC",       "B",      "µg/L",
  "Ba_QC",      "Ba",     "µg/L",
  "Ca_QC",      "Ca",     "µg/L",
  "Cr_QC",      "Cr",     "µg/L",
  "Fe_QC",      "Fe",     "µg/L",
  "Mn_QC",      "Mn",     "µg/L",
  "Pb_QC",      "Pb",     "µg/L",
  "Sr_QC",      "Sr",     "µg/L",
  "Zn_QC",      "Zn",     "µg/L"
)

# 2. Define site labels and order
site_labels <- c(
  "browns_sub"   = "Browns sub.",
  "browns"       = "Browns",
  "winters_up"   = "Winters up.",
  "winters_usgs" = "Winters USGS",
  "davis"        = "Davis",
  "ophir"        = "Ophir"
)


# 3. Total sample count by site
site_counts <- WC_dat %>%
  filter(site_lab %in% names(site_labels)) %>%
  group_by(site_lab) %>%
  summarise(
    n_site = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# 4. Convert chemistry data to long format
chem_long <- WC_dat %>%
  filter(site_lab %in% names(site_labels)) %>%
  select(site_lab, all_of(analyte_info$variable)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(analyte_info$variable),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "concentration"
  ) %>%
  left_join(analyte_info, by = "variable")


# 5. Summarize each analyte by site
chem_summary <- chem_long %>%
  group_by(site_lab, analyte, units) %>%
  summarise(
    n_analyte = sum(!is.na(concentration)),
    mean = if (all(is.na(concentration))) NA_real_
           else mean(concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = if (all(is.na(concentration))) NA_real_
             else median(concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = if (all(is.na(concentration))) NA_real_
          else min(concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = if (all(is.na(concentration))) NA_real_
          else max(concentration, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(site_counts, by = "site_lab") %>%
  mutate(
    site = recode(site_lab, !!!site_labels),
    site = factor(site, levels = unname(site_labels)),
    analyte = factor(
      analyte,
      levels = analyte_info$analyte
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(site, analyte) %>%
  select(
    site, analyte, units,
    n_site, n_analyte,
    mean, median, min, max
  )


# 6. Format for manuscript table
chem_summary_table <- chem_summary %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(mean, median, min, max),
      ~ round(.x, 3)
    ),
    range = if_else(
      !is.na(min) & !is.na(max),
      paste0(
        format(min, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE),
        "–",
        format(max, trim = TRUE, scientific = FALSE)
      ),
      NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    Site = site,
    Analyte = analyte,
    Units = units,
    `Site samples (n)` = n_site,
    `Analyte samples (n)` = n_analyte,
    Mean = mean,
    Median = median,
    Range = range
  )

print(chem_summary_table, n = Inf)

#   "water_chemistry_summary_numeric.csv"
# )

# write_csv(

#   "water_chemistry_summary_manuscript.csv"
```
